entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 3267, Standbuch 1011, Folio: 328v, Schreiber: Lorenz Fries
entries.german: Es hat auch gemelter her Zaisolf ime B. Conraden alsbalt ainen Revers zugestelt vnd sich darin verpflicht, wa sich erfunden der gedachte schlos vnd marckt Haldenbergsteten vorhin des Stiffts W. pfandtschafft vnd zulosen were, das alsdan er von Rosenberg oder seine erben, dem stiffte die ausgelegten xvi c fl in monatsfrist wider ausrichten vnd bezalen solten, ibidem fo. 64. [Nachtragshand am Rand: Rinderuelt, Wammertshausen, Streichental, Ebertsprun, horelbach, Vorbach] Kommentar: Die Nachtragshand erwähnt die Orte: Rinderfeld ( Rinderuelt ), Wermutshausen ( Wammertshausen ), Streichental ( Streichental ) und Ebertsbronn ( Ebertsprun ). Mit horelbach und Vorbach sind möglicherweise die Bäche Holderbach und Vorbach gemeint.
entries.english: The aforesaid Zaisolph von Rosenberg, Herr, gave a reverse to Konrad, Bischof, undertaking that if it were found that the castle and market of Haltenbergstetten had previously been pledged by the bishopric of Würzburg and were redeemable, then he or his heirs would repay the bishopric the 1,600 florins it had advanced within one month. Same book, fol. 64. Marginal addition: Rinderfeld, Wermutshausen, Streichental, Ebertsbronn, Holderbach, Vorbach. Editorial note: The later hand mentions these places; Holderbach and Vorbach may refer to the streams of those names.

facts.content: gave Bishop Konrad a reverse, promising that he or his heirs would repay the bishopric if the castle and market of Haltenbergstetten were found to have been previously pledged and redeemable.
